categories.main_business_segments: Xingyuan Environment Technology Co., Ltd. operates primarily in three segments: equipment manufacturing (notably filter presses), energy storage and dual-carbon innovative businesses, and comprehensive environmental governance including water conservancy dredging, sewage treatment, and ecological restoration. The company also has agricultural and rural ecological businesses focusing on smart farming equipment.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company specializes in advanced filter press technology with over 30 years of experience, including AI-driven automatic filter presses for lithium battery recycling. It employs innovative technologies in sludge dewatering, dredging, and energy storage systems, including battery management systems (BMS) and energy management systems (EMS). The company also develops digital energy platforms integrating big data and AI for energy management.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers span environmental protection, mining, metallurgy, chemical, new energy, food, and pharmaceutical industries. The company serves government and private sectors in water treatment, ecological restoration, and energy storage markets. Major end markets include domestic Chinese regions with growing overseas sales, particularly in Asia, Europe, and Africa.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China, with headquarters and major facilities in Zhejiang Province. It has expanded overseas markets along the Belt and Road Initiative, exporting filter presses to Asia, Europe, and Africa. Domestic operations cover multiple provinces with significant projects in Zhejiang, Jiangsu, Anhui, and others.
categories.supply_chain_position: Xingyuan Environment operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the environmental technology and equipment supply chain, manufacturing key equipment like filter presses and providing engineering, construction, and operational services for environmental projects and energy storage systems.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company focuses on upgrading its equipment manufacturing with intelligent, high-pressure filter presses and expanding its energy storage and dual-carbon businesses aligned with national carbon neutrality goals. R&D priorities include AI automation, new energy storage technologies, carbon asset development, and digital energy platforms. It also emphasizes cost reduction, asset revitalization, and strengthening internal controls and corporate culture.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated through product sales (filter presses, agricultural equipment), engineering and construction contracts (EPC and PPP projects), operation and maintenance of environmental and energy facilities, investment and operation of energy storage projects, carbon asset development and trading, and digital energy services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic player in the filter press industry, recognized as a national-level specialized and innovative 'Little Giant' enterprise. It holds a strong market position in Zhejiang Province and is expanding internationally. Competitors include other environmental equipment manufacturers and engineering service providers in China and abroad.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 1.05 billion, a 43.64% increase year-over-year. Despite a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB -302 million, the loss narrowed by nearly 70% compared to the previous year. The company has total assets around RMB 9.6 billion and is actively reducing losses and improving cash flow, supported by strategic shareholder investments.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Xingyuan Environment emphasizes its deep technical expertise, extensive patent portfolio, and integrated system solutions in filter press manufacturing and environmental engineering. Its AI-enabled automation and advanced energy storage solutions differentiate it in the market. The company leverages strong government and private partnerships, national strategic alignment with carbon neutrality, and a comprehensive service offering from equipment manufacturing to project operation.
